Examples from the Token Identifiers help page.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test {
  echo -s r: $addtok(a.b.c,d,46) $addtok(a.b.c.d,c,46)
  echo -s r: $deltok(a.b.c.d,3,46) $deltok(a.b.c.d,2-3,46)
  echo -s r: $findtok(a.b.c.d,c,1,46) $iif($findtok(a.b.c.d,e,1,46) == $null,none)
  echo -s r: $gettok(a.b.c.d.e,3,46) $gettok(a.b.c.d.e,2-,46) $gettok(a.b.c.d.e,2-4,46)
  echo -s r: $instok(a.b.d,c,3,46) $instok(a.b.d,c,9,46)
  echo -s r: $istok(a.b.c,b,46) $istok(a.b.c,z,46)
  echo -s r: $matchtok(one two three, e, 0, 32) $matchtok(one two three, e, 2, 32)
  echo -s r: $numtok(a.b.c,46) $puttok(a.b.c.d,e,2,46)
  echo -s r: $remtok(a.b.c.d,b,1,46) $remtok(a.b.c.d,e,1,46) $remtok(a.c.c.d,c,1,46)
  echo -s r: $reptok(a.b.c.d,b,e,1,46) $reptok(a.b.c.d,f,e,1,46) $reptok(a.b.a.c,a,e,2,46)
  echo -s r: $sorttok(e.d.c.b.a,46) $sorttok(1.3.5.2.4,46,nr)
  echo -s r: $wildtok(one two three, t*, 0, 32) $wildtok(one two three, t*e, 1, 32)
}
-- output --
r: a.b.c.d a.b.c.d
r: a.b.d a.d
r: 3 none
r: c b.c.d.e b.c.d
r: a.b.c.d a.b.d.c
r: $true $false
r: 2 three
r: 3 a.e.c.d
r: a.c.d a.b.c.d a.c.d
r: a.e.c.d a.b.c.d a.b.e.c
r: a.b.c.d.e 5.4.3.2.1
r: 2 three
